title: nunnezharia microphylla
intro: Nunnezharia microphylla, commonly known as the "Yellow Passionflower," is a species of flowering plant in the family Passifloraceae. The Yellow Passionflower is a climbing vine native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, known for its bright yellow flowers and edible fruit. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions as a sedative and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of the Yellow Passionflower include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits, such as reducing stress and promoting relaxation.
